sources.title: Mount Arapiles-Tooan State Park
sources.excerpt: The Mount Arapiles-Tooan State Park is a state park in the Wimmera plains of western Victoria, Australia. It encompasses Mount Arapiles, Mitre Rock, and the Tooan block. The park covers an area of 7,475 hectares and is valuable for nature conservation, with approximately 14% of the State's flora species represented in the Mount Arapiles area.
